title.zh: 将杜马格特市雷亚尔街更名为Ramon T. Pastor Sr.市长街的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming Real Street in Dumaguete City as Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr. Street
title.orig: An Act Renaming Real Street in Dumaguete City as Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr. Street
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đường Real tại Thành phố Dumaguete thành Đường Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนน Real ในเมือง Dumaguete เป็นถนน Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Jalan Real di Kota Dumaguete menjadi Jalan Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr.
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Jalan Real di Bandar Dumaguete kepada Jalan Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10052_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Real Street in Dumaguete City shall hereinafter be known as Mayor Ramon T. Pastor Sr. Street.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
